text: Aldrees Petroleum & Transport Services Company was established as a family company in 1957 and has been a joint-stock company since 2006.

source.name: ALDREES – About Us: History (company timeline)
source.quote: In 2006 the company witnessed a large stride forward transforming into a joint stock company.
source.note: The same page's timeline also states: 'ALDREES was established as a family company in 1957 by selling oil products.'
